props.title: Born to Engineer, Built to Race
body: Centrale Nantes Formula Student is a student-led association at Centrale Nantes, one of France's top engineering schools.

Founded with the ambition to bring Centrale Nantes to the forefront of Formula Student competition, our team brings together 20 students from all engineering disciplines. United by a shared passion for motorsport and innovation, we design, manufacture, and test a competition race car from scratch every year.

Our mission goes beyond building a fast car. We develop the next generation of engineers through hands-on experience with real-world challenges in design, manufacturing, project management, and business development.
props.imageAlt: CNFS team working on the car

cards.title: Innovation
cards.text: Push the boundaries of student engineering. We explore creative solutions and apply cutting-edge technology to every aspect of our car.

cards.title: Education
cards.text: Bridge the gap between academic theory and real-world application. Every team member gains hands-on experience that shapes their engineering career.

cards.title: Teamwork
cards.text: Learn to collaborate across disciplines. Mechanical, electrical, software, and business students work together toward a single goal.

props.title: 4 Specialized Departments
props.intro: Each department plays a critical role in turning our design into a competitive race car.

depts.name: Conception
depts.text: Chassis design, suspension geometry, powertrain integration, and all mechanical systems. From CAD to manufacturing — every physical component of the car.

depts.name: Electronics
depts.text: High-voltage battery management, motor controllers, sensor integration, data acquisition, and cockpit instrumentation for our electric powertrain.

depts.name: Programmation
depts.text: Vehicle control software, telemetry systems, ECU programming, and simulation tools. The code that makes Falcon drive.

depts.name: Enterprise
depts.text: Sponsorship acquisition, brand management, business presentations, event planning, and partnership relations. The commercial engine of CNFS.

props.title: Our University
props.intro: Centrale Nantes is one of France's leading engineering schools (Grande Ecole), renowned for excellence in mechanical engineering, energy, and naval engineering. Located in Nantes, a vibrant city in western France, our university provides the facilities, expertise, and support that makes CNFS possible.

props.title: The People Behind the Car
props.intro: 20 students organized across 4 specialized departments, led by a dedicated executive team.

props.title: Want to Join the Team?
props.text: We welcome passionate students from all disciplines. Whether you're an engineer, a business student, or a creative - there's a place for you at CNFS.
